integrity: The original contribution claimed here is the endpoint continuous-modulus and phase-sensitive spectral-radius classification, not the established compact Gaussian singular-value results or known boundedness thresholds. All analytic hypotheses and the noncompact boundary are explicit.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional centered quadratic exponential weights at the exact Gaussian bounded/noncompact boundary; no determination of the full ordinary spectrum for real slopes. Older Gaussian-operator representations may yield unstated equivalences. Independent validation is absent.
title: Gaussian spectral multiplicity and a phase-sensitive spectral-radius boundary for Fock weighted compositions
